title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis archive), daily maximum temperature
summary: Gridded reanalysis (modelled) hourly and daily weather from the Open-Meteo archive endpoint, queried here for daily temperature_2m_max in degrees Celsius at a single point. The grid cell returned for the probe was 45.448N, 9.169E at 138 m elevation, not a station reading. Coverage is set by the query (the docs cite ERA5 from 1940 and ECMWF IFS from 2017), so the UC2 windows 2023-06-01 to 2026-03-31 are reachable in probes. The shop location is not confirmed anywhere internal, so the coordinates are an assumption.

fields.name: daily.time
fields.description: Date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), in the requested timezone

fields.name: daily.temperature_2m_max
fields.description: Daily maximum air temperature at 2 m

schema.notes: Response also carries latitude, longitude, elevation, utc_offset_seconds and timezone_abbreviation. The probe response also returned hourly temperature_2m and shortwave_radiation because the register default_query includes an hourly parameter; those were not requested for the daily product.

spatial.code_system: decimal coordinates (WGS84 lat/lon), requested point snapped to a model grid cell
spatial.notes: Coordinates used in probes were 45.46, 9.19 (Milan area), an unconfirmed placeholder. The register default (38.72, -9.14, Lisbon) must not be used. The shop city is not stated in any internal source; the coordinates are an open assumption to record in decisions.md. Returned grid point: 45.448154, 9.169279.

access.request_process: Free tier: GET https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive with latitude, longitude, start_date, end_date, daily=temperature_2m_max, timezone=Europe/Rome. Free tier is non-commercial only and rate-limited (<10,000 calls/day, 5,000/hour, 600/minute). Commercial use needs a paid API subscription (Standard/Professional/Enterprise) per open-meteo.com/en/terms; no subscription has been requested.

quality_notes: Register default_query (Lisbon 38.72/-9.14, UTC, hourly temperature_2m, 2014-01-01..03) is unsuitable for UC2 and was overridden in all probes.

Licence conflict: register says agreement_status not_required_open_data and approved purposes include production, but open-meteo.com/en/terms says the free API is for non-commercial use only and commercial use (including products or promotional activities) needs a paid subscription. The client is a commercial shop, so production use is not covered by the free tier.

Reanalysis (modelled) grid values, not station observations. The shop location is unconfirmed, so the grid point may differ from the shop's real microclimate, which matters for a city-level temperature signal.
Rate limits on the free tier: 10,000 calls/day, 5,000/hour, 600/minute, per IP and application.

Provider docs state the archive reaches back to 1940; the sampled probes returned data for 2023-06-01..03 and 2026-03-25..31 only. No intermediate range was tested, and the full window was not downloaded.
Hourly fields returned by the default_query include shortwave_radiation and temperature_2m; they are unused for the daily product and should not be requested for UC2.
Probes used Milan-area coordinates (45.46, 9.19) as a placeholder. No internal source names the shop city, so the choice is an open assumption to record in decisions.md.

sample_findings: Probe response daily.temperature_2m_max returned numeric values in °C for 2023-06-01..03 (25.3, 25.7, 24.9) and 2025-07-01..03 (35.2, 34.4, 35.1); no nulls or sentinel values appeared in these probes.
Probe response daily.time uses ISO 8601 dates (YYYY-MM-DD) in the requested timezone.
Probe for 2026-03-25..31 returned 7 daily values (e.g. 17.7, 12.8, 15.4 in the visible part), so the archive response covers the recent window end in the sample.
Response also includes hourly temperature_2m and shortwave_radiation because the default hourly parameter was kept; these were not requested for the daily product.
Grid point returned: latitude 45.448154, longitude 9.169279, elevation 138 m. Not a station record.
